reviews.text:
#Sinsa-dong #Dongin-dong

“The best complete collection created with great care”

Dongin-dong is famous for its spicy braised ribs.
I don't really like spicy food, so I don't go for spicy braised ribs.
So, I had zero interest in restaurants that serve spicy braised ribs, including Dongin-dong.

Then, this place became the subject of my interest after I tasted this place.
The pancakes made right at the store are delicious, but the pancakes you order and eat at home are also very delicious, and they retain their flavor even when stored in the refrigerator and reheated.
It was an unimaginable shock to our family, who had made all their pancakes at home until now.
In other words, the quality is so good that it cannot be compared to the pancakes sold in the market, and the synchronization rate with pancakes made at home is very high.

#Round ding
The taste of donggeurangttaeng, which is the basis of the filling, determines the quality of the jeonjip.
This restaurant uses tofu as a filler appropriately to achieve a balance of softness and texture.
Too much tofu is accompanied by a cheap taste, so the ratio with the meat is also important, and this restaurant has a really good ratio.
A ratio that is not too hard, but appropriately soft, and brings out the texture of the meat well.
If you put this together well, you can say that it is close to home-cooked pancakes.
A great donggeurangttaeng that is delicious even when it’s cold.

#Perilla leaf pancake
My favorite pancake, perilla leaf pancake.
Since the round rice cakes are great, the perilla leaf pancake is delicious.
The splendor of a well-filled filling and fragrant perilla leaves.
Best perilla leaf pancake

#Guljeon
I tried oyster pancakes because it was oyster season, and although it was a tasteless dish, it was even more delicious with the addition of the restaurant's Jeonson sauce.
The ultimate in softness.
“Gulddeokgultteok” passes.

#Spicy braised ribs
Spicy but sweet.
Because it contains both the spicy flavor you don't like and the sweet flavor you don't like, you end up eating it as a side dish with drinks rather than feeling delicious.
The meat was good and it was good. This place is really good at pre-processing.

#side dish
The side dishes are really good.
They also sell sweet dongchimi that goes well with alcohol, bean sprouts mixed with spicy braised ribs, and radish vegetables that go well with pancakes.
Salted chili peppers make a very good snack here.

It would be correct to call this collection a complete collection.
The quality, taste, and side dishes of the pancakes are in perfect harmony.

While I was drinking oyster pancake and having a glass of soju

reviews.text:
I really wanted to go there, but it wasn't easy to make a reservation, so I made a reservation a month in advance and went there with my wife. We took reservations by time and were able to make a reservation for the last time at 8:10 on Friday.
The interior is quite brightly lit and has a modern atmosphere. The bright light may feel burdensome, but the decorations and decorations here and there create a softer feel, creating an appropriate harmony.
A service that gives you outerwear as soon as you sit down. A detail with the names of seated guests written on it. From a sincere welcome message to a menu showing the day's dishes. It makes me feel good to feel treated and cared for.

The menu seems to prepare special courses using seasonal ingredients for each season. When I visited in mid-October, dishes with a fall concept were served.
First, the fresh-tasting starter of crab meat peeled and mixed with chrysanthemum and jelly sauce whetted my appetite for a late evening meal.
After that, I got the feeling that the ingredients that brought out the autumn feel, starting with sweet persimmons and horned conches, shad, and yellowtail, were cooked without being burdensome in order to not lose the original taste of the ingredients. I think the sauce and auxiliary ingredients did a good job of supporting the main ingredients.
There were some menus here and there, such as mackerel, beef tongue, and eel, that felt familiar but somewhat strong, with the power of sauce, but they were also mixed appropriately into the overall course composition, which could be a bit bland, so I was very satisfied.
In particular, I personally don't like grilled blue-backed fish because of its fishy taste, but I was impressed by how the mackerel was flavored with fire and the lime and gamtae created a great taste without any fishy smell. To my taste, it was the best tasting mackerel dish other than grilled or stewed. (Even at the highest-end sushi restaurants in Japan, mackerel did not give me much satisfaction. It was just edible?)
As I was writing this review, I vividly remembered the fall shad fry. The gizzard shad is deep-fried in its shell, excluding the head, and the crunchy, savory flavor along with the small bones still makes my mouth water.

There was a liquor pairing course, so I ordered it. The price was not burdensome and it included champagne, sake, and white wine, so it went well with the dishes served. If you like alcohol, be sure to order it.

To sum up, I was happy to find a fine restaurant that I was very satisfied with for the first time in a while. It was a place that satisfied taste, originality, and service, and I think the price was reasonable as well. However, there are minor drawbacks such as no valet service and a lack of parking space, and it is not easy to find because it is not visible at night.
This is a restaurant that I hope will last for a long time, even if it has to endure all the small shortcomings listed above.
